listing.summary: Overhauls planetary generation to create larger, more varied systems with increased object density and rebalanced star types.

description:
page rewritten on June 21, 2025

Procgen Overhaul is a mod that provides an overhaul to how planets are generated. Although not technologically savvy, I have spent a large amount of time trying to understand the base vanilla procgen in an attempt to fine tune it to produce more interesting results without breaking immersion and balance. Whilst at the same time reflecting the original vision of the game

Disclaimer:

- This mod will make systems kinda large because it will aim to fill out more orbits than there typically are in vanilla

- There are consequences to this

- This means that if you want to find a bounty generated in such a system or look for a specific object for an exploration mission, it will take you significantly longer to find it

- In the most recent patch. The potency of Black Holes and Neutron Stars has been reduced to make scanning them easier. As well as encourage colonising Neutron Star systems

Patch Notes:

Spoiler3

- Changed names of various inner newly added Core Worlds to be less jokey. The outer three that occur in Yendore's Domain retained their names

- Made some harsh edits to inner Core Worlds

- Removed all added economies except Morokoon, Bzabzen, Uusimaa (Moronia) and Khyber (Cappuccino)

- The Path of Self-Exiled economies were all removed from the game and said systems are now owned by Luddic Church which means making colonies inside them will invite them to bombard you

- No Bono Sindrian Diktat economy was removed

- Pirate world next to Gumbat has been removed

- All still remaining economies in the mod have been overhauled

- Procgen system tweaked heavily. The chance of "nothing", gas giants, and terrain has been halved. Making it significantly more probable for normal systems to generate

2.1

- Made some incomprehensive changes to the procgen system

- Changed how resources are generated to prevent too many high resource planets from generating. Toxic will no longer force volatiles based on the fact that Dense Atmosphere sets volatiles generation to 100% chance by removing the chance to not spawn volatiles

- Reduced the amount of ruins

- Gave Brown Dwarf systems moody magenta lighting

- Reworked Parkapec, Syzygy and Cappuccino by adding new markets, vast worlds. And lessening the reliance on randomly generated objects

the most recent one as of now (the naming got confusing and i just want to get this over with)

- Made some incomprehensive changes to the procgen system

- Fixed a bug that caused rocky-metallic to not have enough resources as intended

- Made some heavy changes to how many resources spawn per planets. Making stuff more scarce in general. This also improves the chances of being able to use Soil Nanites

- Removed the non-vanilla light change for Brown Dwarves. This lighting can still be found in custom systems

- Swapped the sizes of White Dwarves and Black Holes

- Made Supergiants significantly larger

3.3

- Removed corona and gave Khyber a spooky appearance. This has been done to prevent Tri-Tachyon patrols from ramming themselves into the sun

- Made Toxic planets occur up to temperate climate to reduce the amount of habitable worlds and make the situation of Gumbat actually probable

3.3 hotfix

- Nerfed Gumbat to be a population 4 world instead of population 5, removed Military Base

- Changed Gumbat's corona to not be absent, but instead muted

3.3.1

- Removed the last two economies from the Core Worlds that were not part of the original roster

- Restored less pretentious names for all the Core World added systems

- Removed Luddic Church tags. They no longer prevent the player from colonising these systems

- They do not have anything of value in them anyway

- Restored Cappuccino's original corona size

- Made some changes to Morokoon system. Made it a free port, reduced its population to 5. Removed its mining. This has been done to make it a more realistic economy capable of sustaining itself

3.3.2

- Made all the various strange economies and descriptions hidden in the files active

- Made Brown Dwarves paint systems in an evil infrared glow rather than the green vanilla one

Hotfix

- Increased population of Memory from 2 to 3

Hotfix

- Fixed Memory not having Free Port as intended

3.3.2 latefix

-

Reduced the amount of objects generated in nebula systems to vanilla levels

(never mind)

- Reduced the minimum amount of objects generated in systems to only 2 times the vanilla level instead of 4

- This will make less planets spawn in general on average.

And nebulas becoming less insufferable due to long travel distances to more distant planets

3.3.2.1

- Reworked some custom economies, among others Denyza lost hot condition, Fameless has Light Industry instead of Military Base. Has Patrol HQ, etc.

- Added Null economy in No Bono

- Reduced temperature of blue giants by 1, making them as hot as red supergiants

- Made neutron stars and black holes have decent heat around them making it possible for habitable worlds to occur as well as them having a nice continuum of planets

3.3.2.1 hotfix

- Redownload to apply

- Fixed Gagner being called Syzygy

- Made Arbakan's Lagrange points orbit closer to their related planet. They are now also bigger

3.3.2.2

- Altered appearance of some main Core Worlds

- Eos, Magec, Thule, Al Gebbar and Isirah have been altered

- Yendore's Domain systems have been reworked to have significantly more objects and have more depth

- Syzygy has been reworked as well

- Planets may now generate with a meteor storm trait, the one from Maxios

- Pollution now increases hazard rating by 50%

- Deserts may now spawn in cold areas

- Significantly increased the amount of asteroid rings, Lagrange points and gas giants

- This is more akin to the earlier some versions of the mod in which systems were heavily dominated by these kinds of objects

- Doubled the amount of minimum orbits

- There should still be a variety of objects, but with these there is going to be significantly more cover and systems are going to feel very large

- Neutron stars will now have properly

large and spanning systems around themselves

- Okay, made be a bit of an overstatement. They will have slightly larger more populated systems but not large and spanning unless obviously by being inside a trinary or binary system

- Reduced the chance of nothing around Neutron Stars and they can now spawn gas giants

- Did a similar thing for Brown Dwarves systems

- Brown Dwarves now have the characteristic green light from vanilla rather than magenta

- Cappuccino remains unique as having magenta light

- Syzygy and No Bono are back to having green light

- Added Arbakan economy in the Morokoon system

- Irradiated now has a proper category in planet procgen, as before it didn't have one as it didn't need one in vanilla, cause it had no chance to spawn moons around itself

- In this mod it however can have moons, and thus it needs a proper category

- This will make it spawn with more likely objects such as barren

- It will also prevent a rare bug in which a tiny gas giant might orbit it

- Lava minor no longer enforced with very hot temperature, instead hot, and will go down to very hot if close to a star

- Other barren worlds than rocky_metallic are allowed to spawn in close proximity to a very hot object now. With the exception of rocky_ice obviously

- Increased the chance of ring_special and decreased the chance of ring_nothing (ring nothing is turned off in vanilla, in this mod it serves to affect the amount of rings spawning around planets in close proximity to a heat source (star)

- This has been given to prevent large spanning rings surrounding gas giants to spawn near stars as often, where logically the star should simply steal the gas giant's rings for itself

Hotfix

- Fixed Neutron Stars not having enough range

- Increased the probability of rings and gas giants spawning across Neutron Stars to make them more populated

Hotfix-1

- Removed harsh modifiers of population from a lot of stars homogenising them in spawning vast amounts of objects

- Did not remove harsh modifiers from age categories, so there should still be massive differences in-between certain objects

- These modifiers had the issue of compounding certain traits, such as spawning too much nothing or rings. Or they just locked out interesting options for certain systems

- Granted a lot of these had good reasons

- Blue giants not having that many habitable worlds. Neutron stars (something I added) not having any. But then there was stuff like Red Giants having only barren worlds and no rings

- This has been removed, you can now find a terran world around a neutron star if you are lucky. And you will now find gas giants around brown dwarves as well, etc.

- The only modifiers that were left in place with the exception of those mentioned about age, were the stuff like more lava, cryovolcanic and toxic worlds around binary and trinary star systems

- And still more irradiated worlds around neutron stars and now black holes. The modifier was reduced from times 10 to times 2 however

- Restored the original appearance of Eldfell

Hotfix-2

- Cappuccino rings now less intense in appearance on the map

- Habitable worlds of category 3, as in tundra, jungle, arid, water and eccentric have had their chance equalised. With the exception of water which is twice as likely to occur, the other ones are all equally likely to occur on their respective turf

- Extended appearance range of jungle, tundra and arid into semi-temperate regions

- Desert can no longer occur in temperate to cold regions

- Irradiated chance of occurrence halved

- This should result in more and more varied habitable worlds

3.4

- Placing additional systems in the Unused section

- New Systems mod is now considered basically scrapped content as it requires too much effort to get right, and additionally interrupts with the flow of the in-game economies and the narrative of the game

- Halved the probability of encountering a habitable world, this is now basically like in vanilla where habitable worlds are few and far between, except there is now a high probability that the habitable core world will be kinda awful

- Have fun

Hotfix

- Ring special will no longer spawn until cold zone

3.4.1

- Restored Supergiant stars, white dwarf and black hole sizes to how they are in vanilla

- This is because giant supergiant stars look too pixelated, large black holes do not make sense from physics perspective and white dwarves although somewhat baffling are probably probable. David seems to know something about physics, clearly that I don't, so imma trust him and Alex on this one

Latefix

- Habitable worlds can no longer spawn around black holes (this is because of some harsh radiation that would be typically associated with black holes. As their light gets accelerated into being high gamma radiation by the relativity effects or something like that?

- Black holes now pull with twice the strength and deprave ships of combat readiness twice as fast as they do in vanilla

- Restored some of the

aiDescription: Expands system sizes by filling more orbits and significantly increasing the frequency of asteroid rings, Lagrange points, and gas giants. Rebalances planet generation to make non-habitable worlds like toxic, lava, and gas giants more viable and interesting. Adjusts star properties, including reducing the potency of black holes and neutron stars, to improve gameplay balance and exploration.

changelog.3.4.1.2.2.4:
- Moved the mod to releases in GitHub and replaced the download link with an actual download link
- Shrunk the amount of orbits by half of what was added
changelog.3.4.1.2.2.3:
- Lava and lava minor worlds can now occur in cold territories, adding to very hot and hot climate planets to nebula systems, and general more distant planets from stars
- These will occur somewhat commonly

- Note that very hot and hot does not negate cold and dark
changelog.3.4.1.2.2.2:
- Reduced the max amount of generated orbits in systems by a flat 2, this moderately affects the size of planetary systems making them generate on average slightly less further, but not by much

- Black Holes and Neutron Stars nerfed significantly. Their push has been reduced by a factor of 2. And the CR decay affect by a factor of 5. For the Black Hole, the vanilla value was used for reduction instead of the buffed one
